notes.title: Update v0.3.0.k_EA is now live!
notes.content:
Heat Death v0.3.0.k_EA is now live! This update focuses on improving the game balance based on community feedback. 

What's New and Improved:

- Challenge Adjustments: We’ve reduced enemy counts in both easy and normal difficulty levels to smooth out your gameplay experience.

- Power Boost: Power cells now add 600 power capacity to your train (previously 500).

- Enhanced Energy: Fission fuel generators now generate more power—+300 in easy mode and +240 in normal mode (up from +180).

- Stronger Trains: Build 33% heavier trains with the same acceleration power.

- Slower Deterioration: Modules now deteriorate slower in easy mode.

- Warmer Interiors: Staying inside your train before constructing a heater is now 15% warmer.

- Reduced Enemy Damage: Enemies deal less damage in both easy and normal modes, giving you a fighting chance.

- Tougher Scrappers: Scrappers are now twice as durable in normal mode and completely indestructible in easy mode (unless you blast them directly!).

- Solar Panel: The Solar panel produces 60 power under the starlight, and it won't deteriorate anymore. 

- Blueprint balance: Blueprint requirement for certain modules and crafting recipes has been reduced.

- Resources: We've added more materials to the stations. Also, it's more likely to find resources inside the lockers and enemies.

- Bug Fixes: We’ve fixed a few bugs affecting the battery charger and SeedEx placement.

- Tweaks and More: Various tweaks and bug fixes to enhance your overall experience.

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
Welcome to Early Access Launch day!

The wait is over! Heat Death: Survival Train Early Access launches in just a few hours.

What to Expect:

 An Expanded World: Explore a significantly larger map, three times the size of the public demo.
 A Customizable Arsenal: Upgrade your train with over 20 unique modules.

Join Us for the Launch Stream!

Launch Trailer
Learn more about the game before the launch with our brand-new trailer, premiering on YouTube 2 hours before Early Access release: Our YouTube Channel

Your journey begins now...

notes.title: Major public demo update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781887/6e1ac10d70cc98a1340b77962ced9bce9dbed350.jpgWe’re excited to announce that Heat Death v0.2.5.m_demo is live on the Steam public branch. 

Here is what's new:
- Airborne Scout Drones (New Enemy Type): The old scout drones have been replaced with new airborne drones that are faster and more challenging to overcome.
- Rapid Burst (New Train Weapon): The Rapid Burst weapon uses train power instead of ammo. This weapon is designed to defend the train against the new drones.
- Heat as a Resource: This community-suggested system now physically propagates heat on the train, meaning you must consider structural module insulation (e.g., walls are better insulators than windows). Certain modules (like engines) will produce small amounts of heat, but if you keep the doors open during a storm, all of it will dissipate.
- Physical Train: Train physics is now more realistic. Each module has mass, and as you build them, the train becomes heavier, reducing its acceleration. Storms will also change the train's air drag, reducing its top speed during storms.
- Fall Damage: You'll now take fall damage. Please let us know how this affects your play style.
- Blueprint as a Resource: By popular demand, you can now unlock the modules you want instead of relying on random unlocks! Blueprints are now a collectible resource in your inventory.
- New Structure Unlocking System: Structural modules are no longer available from the start. You’ll need to reach train stations to unlock them.
- Fission Reactor (New Module): This powerful module generates energy using fuel. However, it’s radioactive while in operation and produces highly radioactive waste that must be stored or disposed of safely!
- Module Deterioration: Modules like the Engine, Dynamo, and Fission Reactor will now wear down over time, adding a new challenge to maintaining your train.
- Difficulty Levels and Game Balance: We’ve introduced new difficulty levels and rebalanced the game accordingly. You can adjust the difficulty level at any time during your adventure.
- Compass: The HUD now has a new compass UI that shows enemies while you're in battle.
- Infinite Player Inventory: Your inventory is now infinite! However, if you carry items beyond the limit, you won't be able to run or jump.
- Other Changes and Bug Fixes

Please note that: Due to the extensive changes, we had to reset the save files in this version, but you'll be able to load save files from this version in the first Early access release.

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

We're thrilled to announce that Heat Death: Survival Train Demo v0.1.12.j is now rolling out on the public branch of Steam! This update focuses on train customization, bringing new ways to customize your train by adding more modules, stickers, color changes, etc. 

For a full changelog, please refer to this post.

Steam Deck and Linux users: You can use Proton 7.0-6 to avoid the repeated installation of prerequisites every time you start the game, or you can stay on Proton Experimental and either install or uninstall the recommended prerequisites every time the message pops out to bypass it. The game will start right after, either in the install or uninstall case.

notes.title: Open beta v0.1.12.e
notes.content:
Hello survivors and engineers!

We're rolling out the new open beta version of Heat Death for everyone to test and enjoy!

How to update to open beta?
Here's how you can opt-in:
- Go to your Steam library and right-click on "Heat Death: Survival Train Demo".
- Select "Properties", then navigate to "Betas".
- From the drop-down menu, choose "open_beta".
- Let Steam take care of the game update.

What's new in v0.1.12.e?
Here's a rundown of the fresh changes in this version:
- Prologue Redesign: We've given the Prologue a makeover, with updated quests and a rebalanced resource system.
- New Build Menu: By pressing the "Q" button, you can access a wheel/grid menu for building, scrapping, and more.
- Moving Module: The "Move" option in the build menu lets you shift modules without having to scrap them. Please note, scrapping modules will now only return a fraction of the resources used to build them.
- Module Color Change: You can now add a dash of color to your train by changing the color of the structural elements!
- Stickers: Add a personal touch to your train with stickers! You'll need a new resource called “Cartridge” for this.
- Scout Drones: We've added two scout drones to the game! You'll need to either travel during the storm to avoid them or destroy them using the Icicle.
- Module Repair: Scout drones can cause damage to your train. Any critically damaged modules won't function until they are repaired.
- New Structural Modules: You can now add fences, half-walls, half-floors, and half-ceiling tiles to your train for more customization!
- New Weapons System: Direct control of weapons is no longer available. Instead, you’ll need to build a new “Weapon Controller” module to operate them remotely. Don't forget to load them with ammo before you start firing!
- Motion Sickness: We've added a new setting under the "Other" tab that allows you to disable camera shake, which could help reduce motion sickness for some players.
- Performance Optimization: We've revamped part of the building system, which should now offer improved performance when building a train with numerous modules.
- Various bug fixes, optimizations, and tweaks.

Public version (non-beta version) revert:
Due to VC++ Runtime issues for some players (mostly on Steam Deck), we've reverted the public version back to 0.1.7.i. If you played the public version in the last two days without any issues, feel free to opt into the open beta and continue playing.

We're always excited to hear your feedback and we thank you for being a part of this journey with us!
